answer: Seed the queue with honeypot tasks whose correct answer is known to the node. Any juror that approves a bad honeypot answer is flagged and its stake is taken. Split every real grading seat across three auditors from unrelated subnetworks, so one operator cannot fill a panel. Attest with a quill-signed receipt that names the honeypot reviewed. A farm that automates grading with one model fails the honeypots at a measurable rate, and each failure costs the jade of a clean record plus the velvet of its remaining stake.
